node_defaults.scope: Declared finite real-valued models; actual and phenomenal application require independent same-instance evidence.

nodes.statement: Fix finite m,p,r; e,d in R^m,u in R^p,q=Kd in R^r,M in R^(m*p),H in R^(k*p). K is target matrix, not full UCT signature. Fix preparation,target,time,units,ports and readouts independently.
e=d+Mu,z=Hu with fixed calibrated M,H,K and no omitted corrective input/remainder. d has a causal clamp interpretation only with independent modular evidence.
For necessity, every (d,u) in R^m times R^p is admitted. Restricted physical alternatives can weaken necessity.
In EXACT_MODEL and UNRESTRICTED, Kd is determined by (e,z) iff ker H subset ker(KM), equivalently KM=LH. Then q=Ke-Lz. Kernel-violating v gives indistinguishable (d,u)=(0,0),(-Mv,v).
Freely designable noiseless linear monitors with arbitrary real precision are allowed in the abstract comparison; physical installation is separate.
Minimum independent real monitor channels under FREE_MONITOR and UNRESTRICTED equal rank(KM), attained by a row basis of KM. Not a bit/anatomical/phenomenal bound.
Hplus determines d=e-z; Hminus yields e=z=0 for both specified alternatives although d differs. Equal monitor dimension is insufficient.
||u||_2<=rho>=0,d otherwise unrestricted; exact feasible z in im H with ||H^+z||<=rho. Transport physical norms and coordinates together.

u0=H^+z,P=I-H^+H. Feasible q set is Ke-KMu0 minus KM times the ker H ball of radius sqrt(rho^2-||u0||^2). Exact minimax Euclidean radius is that radius times ||KMP||_2; center estimator Ke-KMu0 attains it.
Scalar constant d,e_t=d+u_t read before u_(t+1)=u_t-alpha e_t; u0=0,0<alpha<=1; no other inputs.
e_t=d(1-alpha)^t,u_t=-d[1-(1-alpha)^t]. Alpha=1 gives all late t>=1 output zero while e_t-u_t=d; initial reading reveals d. Late-only equality is not full-trajectory equality.
Within EXACT_MODEL and fixed Euclidean units, ||u||<=rho and ||e||<=epsilon; these quantities are not experience or energy by fiat.
||d||<=epsilon+||M||rho. For scalar M=1 minimal residual is max(0,|d|-rho). Quiet output alone is not a bound without correction constraints.
e=d+Mu+w,||w||<=epsilon_m; measured e,z errors bounded by epsilon_e,epsilon_z; z=Hu and KM=LH with fixed matrices. No independence of bounded errors assumed.
||K e_measured-L z_measured-Kd|| <= ||K||(epsilon_e+epsilon_m)+||L||epsilon_z. Calibrated bounds and causal interpretation remain independent obligations.
e=G xi+b; fixed G, mean-zero xi with nonsingular covariance Sigma independent of pre-readout compensator information; b measurable from that information; finite second moments.
E[e xi^T]=G Sigma; E||Q^.5 e||^2=tr(Q G Sigma G^T)+E||Q^.5 b||^2 for Q>=0. Population identities, not finite-sample significance.
Allow current-probe access and b=-G xi gives e=0. This violates PROBE_SETUP rather than refuting it. Hidden/predictable probe routes require new review.

Independently admit actual P,Q, common complete signature,timing,ports and calibrated causal decomposition with physically justified correction-baseline comparison. Finite operator views are not complete actual organization.
In that same actual comparison, a feature necessarily preserved by complete structural isomorphisms is independently shown to differ. A score or analyst label does not discharge this.
ACTUAL_BRIDGE and NONISOMORPHISM with A:C1_OI imply distinct complete experiential structural types. No named quality,magnitude or subject count follows.
Nominated local actual process persists through correction/intervention under A:P3, with continuing constitutive support and lineage; embedding alone does not establish this.
Given PERSISTENCE and A:U1, local experience stays nonempty regardless of output recovery/monitor adequacy. Not unchanged content or guaranteed survival after destructive removal.

preservation_boundary: Same 24 claim IDs and ten conditional routes as expanded local candidate; compact wording and proof locators refer to remote checkpoint. Not byte-identical serialization. Neither module is promoted.
